title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Judges 1: Judah goes up first, Othniel takes Kiriath Sepher, and the tribes leave Canaanites in the land.

questions.text: After the death of Joshua, which tribe did Yahweh say should go up first against the Canaanites?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:2 says Yahweh answered, "Judah shall go up."

questions.text: What did they cut off when they caught Adoni-Bezek?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:6 says they cut off his thumbs and his big toes.

answers.text: His right hand and his nose
His thumbs and his big toes

questions.text: How many kings did Adoni-Bezek say had scavenged under his table?
questions.explanation: Adoni-Bezek said seventy kings, with their thumbs and big toes cut off, had scavenged under his table.

questions.text: What was the name of Hebron before that?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:10 says the name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.

questions.text: Who took Kiriath Sepher and received Achsah as his wife?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:13 says Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it and was given Achsah.

questions.text: What did Achsah ask her father to give her besides land in the South?
questions.explanation: In Judges 1:15 she asked for springs of water, and Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

questions.text: Why could Judah not drive out the inhabitants of the valley?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:19 says they could not drive them out because they had chariots of iron.

answers.text: Yahweh had told Judah to spare them

questions.text: Where did the Jebusites keep living with the children of Benjamin?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:21 says the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.

questions.text: What did the man who showed the entrance into Bethel name the city he built in the land of the Hittites?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:26 says he built a city and called its name Luz.

questions.text: Who forced the children of Dan into the hill country?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:34 says the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country.
